这个提交里这个文件还叫别的名字，下面是这个提交的全部改动 ·: This file had a different name in this commit; all changes in this commit are shown below ·
这个文件是在这个提交里改成现在的名字的，下面是这个提交的全部改动 ·: This file was renamed to its current name in this commit; all changes in this commit are shown below ·
这个文件有冲突：在编辑器里解决后，点「标记为已解决」暂存它: This file has conflicts: resolve them in the editor, then click “Mark as resolved” to stage it
这个目录是仓库，可以打开: This directory is a repository and can be opened
这个系统上还不支持开机自启: Automatic startup is not yet supported on this system
这是 git 或 ssh 的原始提示。填的内容只交给它，不会保存。: This is the original prompt from git or ssh. Your input is passed only to it and is not saved.
远程 {remote} 上的分支 {branch} 会被删除，其他人也会看不到它: Branch {branch} on remote {remote} will be deleted and will no longer be visible to others. Local branches are not affected.
远程分支 {to} 上的提交会被本地 {name} 的覆盖。只有 {to} 还停: Commits on remote branch {to} will be overwritten by those on local branch {name}. This only succeeds if {to} is still where it was when you last fetched (--force-with-lease).
远程分支上有本地没有的提交，所以被拒绝了。先拉取（或获取后变基），再推送。: Rejected because the remote branch has commits that are not available locally. Pull (or fetch and rebase) before pushing.
远程的名字里不能有空格和斜杠: Remote names cannot contain spaces or slashes
连不上远程。检查网络、代理和远程的地址，然后再试。: Cannot connect to the remote. Check the network, proxy, and remote address, then try again.
连接参数改了，正在按新的重新连接。已经开着的这台服务器上的标签页还用着原来的连接: Connection settings changed; reconnecting with the new settings. Tabs already open on this server still use the old connection; close and reopen them for the changes to take effect.
连续滚动（每帧 {BENCH_ROWS_PER_FRAME} 行）帧间隔: Continuous scrolling ({BENCH_ROWS_PER_FRAME} rows per frame) frame interval
选一个文件查看改动: Select a file to view its changes
选一个文件，看它的历史或逐行追溯: Select a file to view its history or blame
里面开着的 {tabs} 个标签页会关掉。仓库还在仓库列表里，随时可以再打开。: The {tabs} open {tabs|tab|tabs} in it will close. The repositories stay in the repository list and can be reopened at any time.
